# MediaFlowSwift

> MediaFlowSwift is a footage manager for video creators on the Mac, made by Long Road Software LLC (Tennessee, USA). It tracks every clip from a shoot: import from cards and phones, sort and review, organize into folders ready for editing, free up space only after each copy is verified, archive, and publish to YouTube.

## What it does
- Imports from SD cards, USB drives, folders, iPhone and cameras connected over USB
- Review with frame-accurate preview, Rapid Review, star ratings, tags, notes and selects; your own categories, with optional suggestions from an on-device model or a provider you choose
- Speech transcripts, place names, weather and a shoot map
- Copies clips into category folders at each project's destination (network share, external drive or a folder on the Mac)
- Archives to numbered drives with a record of what is where; restore and relink; "Library Moved" repoints every project at a new drive
- Editing drive: move a project to a fast SSD and back, with changes carried across and checked
- Proxies for footage on a network share
- PDF, HTML and CSV reports
- Studio Pro: drafts YouTube titles, descriptions, chapters and tags; uploads to YouTube as a private draft (advanced; needs the user's own Google Cloud project); reads back views, watch time and subscribers; shared database server across several Macs

## Requirements
macOS 14 or later on a Mac with Apple silicon.

## Pricing
14-day free trial of the full app, no card required. Studio: USD 4.99/month or USD 49.99/year. Studio Pro: USD 9.99/month or USD 99.99/year. Yearly is about 17% off the monthly price. One plan covers one person on up to three Macs. Payment through Paddle, merchant of record. Full refund within 14 days.

## Privacy
No account and no usage data. The app checks for updates and, once a key is entered, checks the licence; every other outside service is off until the user turns it on.
